- conda-forge main

python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
CodeCarbon is a Python package that estimates the carbon emissions produced by
computer programs, from straightforward algorithms to deep neural networks.

It measures the electricity consumed by the machine it runs on and converts it
to CO2 using the carbon intensity of the local electricity grid, taking into
account your computing infrastructure, location, usage and running time. It can
be used as a Python context manager, a decorator, or from the command line, and
works either standalone or by reporting to the CodeCarbon API and dashboard.
about.summary: Track and reduce CO2 emissions from your computing

name: codecarbon
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "codecarbon" %}
{% set version = "3.3.1" %}


package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a10bdb6d59f30ed299780f9df6b7c77f7887eb6b67887293ef2e52f160b820a9

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  entry_points:
    - codecarbon = codecarbon.cli.main:main
    - carbonboard = codecarbon.viz.carbonboard:main
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - arrow
    - authlib >=1.2.1
    - click
    - joserfc >=1.0.0
    - nvidia-ml-py
    - pandas >=2.3.3
    - prometheus_client
    - psutil >=6.0.0
    - py-cpuinfo
    - pycountry
    - pydantic >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
    - questionary
    - rapidfuzz
    - requests
    - rich
    - typer

test:
  imports:
    - codecarbon
    - codecarbon.core
    - codecarbon.external
    - codecarbon.output_methods
  commands:
    - pip check
    - codecarbon --help
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

outputs:
  - name: codecarbon

  # Metapackage mirroring `pip install codecarbon[carbonboard]`: the optional
  # Dash-based local dashboard behind the `carbonboard` command.
  - name: codecarbon-viz
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('codecarbon', exact=True) }}
        - dash
        - dash-bootstrap-components >1.0.0
        - fire
    test:
      imports:
        - codecarbon.viz.carbonboard
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://codecarbon.io/
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Track and reduce CO2 emissions from your computing
  description: |
    CodeCarbon is a Python package that estimates the carbon emissions produced by
    computer programs, from straightforward algorithms to deep neural networks.

    It measures the electricity consumed by the machine it runs on and converts it
    to CO2 using the carbon intensity of the local electricity grid, taking into
    account your computing infrastructure, location, usage and running time. It can
    be used as a Python context manager, a decorator, or from the command line, and
    works either standalone or by reporting to the CodeCarbon API and dashboard.
  dev_url: https://github.com/mlco2/codecarbon
  doc_url: https://docs.codecarbon.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - PertuyF
    - benoit-cty
    - inimaz
    - SaboniAmine
